in_hebrew.name: Alvis
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Noble, wise, or helper
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Alvis הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Latin word ‘albus,’ meaning ‘white,’ ‘wise,’ or ‘helping.’ Alvis can also be derived from the Old English word ‘elfsige,’ meaning ‘elf-dedicated’ or ‘elf-sige,’ meaning ‘elf-power’ or ‘elf-victory.’ In Christian tradition, Alvis is believed to represent the divine wisdom and protection of God.
